notes: While δυνατός is the go-to word for physical strength, it is also very commonly used to describe intensity in other areas, such as loud sounds (δυνατή μουσική) or powerful winds (δυνατός άνεμος).

Do not confuse this with ισχυρός; while both mean strong or powerful, ισχυρός often implies influence, authority, or abstract strength, whereas δυνατός is more frequently used for physical power and tangible force.
